test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only 3 people sit between C and E when counted from the right of C. Only 1 person sits between E and G when counted from the left of E. F sits immediate to the left of D. Only 2 people sit between B and F when counted from the left of B. How many people sit between G and B when counted from the left of G?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only 3 people sit between C and E when counted from the right of C.

Only 1 person sits between E and G when counted from the left of E.

F sits immediate to the left of D. Only 2 people sit between B and F when counted from the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d71d1cc6a35a19a20c88480f08b132496fda27ea7fc542590fb2f9a7a373d1b9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c25e7e2fa2943b65343427934696afe4eef19e21133d85c90af24c9c93b0e7.png] 

Thus, 0 people sit between G and B when counted from the left of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
